_about: Trading words the translator must use, per language (written 2026-11-27). Keys are the English terms; the meaning notes are in _terms. Change _version and every cached string with a glossary term is re-done once by Gemini.

_terms.long: a buy position that profits when price rises
_terms.short: a sell position that profits when price falls
_terms.spot: the spot market (buying the coin itself)
_terms.bullish: expecting or showing a price rise
_terms.bearish: expecting or showing a price fall
_terms.support: a price level where falls tend to stop
_terms.resistance: a price level where rises tend to stop
_terms.candle: a price candlestick on a chart
_terms.trendline: a line drawn along highs or lows
_terms.pullback: a temporary move back against the trend
_terms.margin: collateral held for a leveraged position
_terms.liquidation: forced closing of a leveraged position
_terms.funding rate: periodic payment between longs and shorts on perpetuals
_terms.order book: the list of buy and sell orders
_terms.take profit: an order that closes a trade at a target
_terms.stop loss: an order that closes a trade to limit loss
_terms.entry: the price where a trade is opened
_terms.transaction fee: the fee paid to send a transaction
_terms.gas fee: the network fee on Ethereum-style chains
_terms.whale: a holder of a very large amount
_terms.wick: the thin line of a candle (shadow)
_terms.dominance: Bitcoin's share of total market cap
_terms.stablecoin: a coin pegged to a currency, e.g. USDT
